extra_vocab.en: an idea for a new product or plan
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，concept 指還在開發中的產品構想，也就是 Nimble Plus 這款嬰兒推車的設計概念。簡報者用 next concept 帶出下一個要介紹的產品。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: concept 是可數名詞，常說 the concept of + N 或 the concept behind + N，單數前要加 a 或 the。

example.en: Our team presented three new concepts to the client yesterday.
example.zh: 我們的團隊昨天向客戶提出了三個新構想。

example.en: The product concept is simple: a stroller that moves in any direction.
example.zh: 這個產品概念很簡單：一台可以朝任何方向移動的嬰兒推車。

example.en: Let me explain the basic concept before we look at the details.
example.zh: 在看細節之前，讓我先說明基本概念。

example.en: We will test the concept with real customers next month.
example.zh: 我們下個月會用真實顧客來測試這個構想。

examples.en: Today I'd like to introduce a new concept for our spring campaign.
examples.zh: 今天我想介紹我們春季活動的一個新構想。

examples.en: The managers liked the concept, but they asked about the cost.
examples.zh: 經理們喜歡這個構想，但他們詢問了成本。

examples.en: Attached is a short document that explains the concept in more detail.
examples.zh: 附件是一份簡短文件，更詳細地說明這個構想。

examples.en: Customers quickly understood the concept behind our new travel app.
examples.zh: 顧客很快就理解了我們新旅遊應用程式背後的概念。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音都有點像，但 concert 是「音樂會」，和構想無關。

example.en: The company held a concert for its employees and their families.
example.zh: 公司為員工和他們的家人舉辦了一場音樂會。

similar.diff: idea 比較口語，任何想法都可以用；concept 常指有一定設計方向的產品或計畫構想。

example.en: Thanks for sharing your idea about the new packaging design.
example.zh: 謝謝你分享你對新包裝設計的想法。

similar.diff: plan 偏重具體步驟與時程；concept 只是初步的整體構想。

example.en: The marketing plan includes a budget and a clear schedule.
example.zh: 這份行銷計畫包含預算和明確的時程。

example.en: The new bag design is light and easy to carry.
example.zh: 這款新包包的設計很輕，也很好攜帶。

example.en: Our proposal was accepted by the committee last week.
example.zh: 我們的提案上週被委員會接受了。

example.en: The engineers tested the prototype in a real store.
example.zh: 工程師在真實的商店裡測試了這個原型。

senses.en: an early idea for a new product or plan

example.en: The designer showed us a concept for a lighter laptop bag.
example.zh: 設計師向我們展示了一款更輕筆電包的構想。

senses.en: a general idea about how something works
senses.distinguish: 看到 the concept of + 抽象事物時，通常是「概念、觀念」；指向某個新產品或新計畫時，才是「構想」。

example.en: Many new employees find the concept of flexible hours difficult at first.
example.zh: 許多新員工一開始覺得彈性工時的概念很難懂。

extra_vocab.zh: 升級、改進成更好的版本
extra_vocab.en: to change something into a newer or better version
extra_vocab.note: 文章中的 upgraded version 是「升級後的版本」。upgraded 由動詞 upgrade 的過去分詞變成形容詞，放在名詞前，說明 Nimble Plus 是原版的改良版。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 upgrade A to B（把 A 升級成 B）；也可以不接受詞，說 upgrade to a new plan。動詞重音在後面 /ʌpˈɡreɪd/，名詞重音在前面 /ˈʌpɡreɪd/。

example.en: She upgrades her laptop every three years to keep it fast.
example.zh: 她每三年升級一次筆電，讓它保持快速。

example.en: The latest upgrades make the app faster and easier to use.
example.zh: 最新的升級讓這個應用程式更快、更好用。

example.en: The IT team upgraded all office computers over the weekend.
example.zh: 資訊部門在週末把所有辦公室電腦都升級了。

example.en: The upgraded model has a larger screen and a longer battery life.
example.zh: 升級後的機型有更大的螢幕和更長的電池續航力。

example.en: We are upgrading our customer database, so it may be slow today.
example.zh: 我們正在升級客戶資料庫，所以今天可能會比較慢。

example.en: We need to upgrade the system before the busy season starts.
example.zh: 我們需要在旺季開始前升級系統。

example.en: Gold members receive a free upgrade when they book a room.
example.zh: 金卡會員訂房時可以獲得免費升級。

example.en: The software upgrade will be available to all users next Monday.
example.zh: 軟體升級將在下週一開放給所有使用者。

example.en: Many customers upgrade to the premium plan after the free trial.
example.zh: 許多顧客在免費試用後會升級成高級方案。

examples.en: We plan to upgrade our website before the new product launch.
examples.zh: 我們打算在新產品上市前升級網站。

examples.en: Please let me know if you want to upgrade your account.
examples.zh: 如果你想升級帳戶，請告訴我。

examples.en: The company decided to upgrade its old machines to save energy.
examples.zh: 公司決定升級舊機器以節省能源。

confusable.diff: update 是把資訊或軟體更新成最新內容，不一定變得更好；upgrade 是換成等級更高或功能更強的版本。

example.en: Please update the price list before you send it to clients.
example.zh: 寄給客戶之前，請先更新價目表。

confusable.diff: renew 是期限到了之後再延續，例如合約或會員資格；upgrade 是換成更好的。

example.en: Please renew your contract before the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前續約。

similar.diff: improve 範圍較廣，任何事物變好都能用；upgrade 常指設備、軟體或服務換成更高等級。

example.en: We need to improve our customer service this year.
example.zh: 我們今年需要改善客戶服務。

example.en: Training can improve how fast our staff solve problems.
example.zh: 訓練可以提升我們員工解決問題的速度。

example.en: We will replace the old copier with a new one.
example.zh: 我們會用新的影印機取代舊的。

example.en: Please send me the final version of the report.
example.zh: 請把報告的最終版本寄給我。

example.en: Our company will upgrade its mobile app next quarter.
example.zh: 我們公司下一季會升級行動應用程式。

example.en: The upgrade cost less than buying a new computer.
example.zh: 這次升級比買一台新電腦便宜。

senses.en: to make a product or system newer or better

example.en: The engineers upgraded the wheels so they turn more smoothly.
example.zh: 工程師升級了輪子，讓它們轉動得更順暢。

senses.en: to give someone a better seat, room, or service
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人，或是座位、房間時，通常是「升等」；受詞是設備或軟體時，是「升級」。

example.en: The airline upgraded me to business class because the flight was full.
example.zh: 因為班機客滿，航空公司把我升等到商務艙。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，oncoming traffic 指朝家長和嬰兒推車迎面駛來的車流。推車擋住視線時，家長比較看不清楚這些車。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: oncoming 只放在名詞前面，例如 oncoming traffic；不說 The car is oncoming。

example.en: Drivers must watch for oncoming traffic before they turn left.
example.zh: 駕駛在左轉前必須注意迎面而來的車流。

example.en: The driver slowed down when he saw an oncoming vehicle.
example.zh: 駕駛看到迎面而來的車輛時放慢了速度。

example.en: Bright oncoming headlights made it hard for her to see the road.
example.zh: 迎面而來的明亮車頭燈讓她很難看清路面。

examples.en: Look both ways and wait for oncoming cars to pass.
examples.zh: 請左右看，等迎面而來的車子過去。

examples.en: Staff should be careful of oncoming trucks near the factory gate.
examples.zh: 員工在工廠大門附近應小心迎面而來的卡車。

examples.en: The road was narrow, so oncoming buses were a real problem.
examples.zh: 路很窄，所以迎面而來的公車真的是個問題。

confusable.diff: upcoming 是時間上「即將到來」的活動或事件；oncoming 是空間上朝你迎面而來的東西。

example.en: Please check the schedule for our upcoming meeting next week.
example.zh: 請查看我們下週即將舉行的會議的時程表。

confusable.diff: incoming 指「正在進來的」，如來電、郵件或新上任的人；不是指迎面而來的車。

example.en: The incoming manager will join our team next month.
example.zh: 新上任的經理下個月會加入我們的團隊。

similar.diff: approaching 可指任何正在靠近的人、車或時間，不一定迎面；oncoming 強調面對面朝你來。

example.en: An approaching train sounded its horn at the crossing.
example.zh: 一列接近中的火車在平交道鳴了喇叭。

similar.diff: 比較口語，是 oncoming 的簡單說法，放在名詞後面說明。

example.en: A bike was coming toward us on the narrow path.
example.zh: 一輛腳踏車在窄路上朝我們迎面騎來。

example.en: Traffic is heavy near the station in the morning.
example.zh: 早上車站附近的車流很多。

example.en: Only company vehicles may park in this area.
example.zh: 只有公司車輛可以停在這個區域。

example.en: The driver stopped to let the children cross the road.
example.zh: 駕駛停下來讓孩子們過馬路。

extra_vocab.note: 文章中 be more visible to drivers 的意思是讓駕駛更容易看到家長。家長站在推車旁邊，比躲在推車後面更顯眼，也比較安全。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: visible 後面常接 to + 人，表示「對某人來說看得見」，不接 for。

example.en: The warning sign must be visible to all visitors.
example.zh: 警告標示必須讓所有訪客都看得到。

example.en: The company logo is clearly visible on the front of the box.
example.zh: 公司標誌清楚地印在盒子正面。

example.en: A highly visible location can bring more customers to a shop.
example.zh: 非常顯眼的位置可以為商店帶來更多顧客。

example.en: The new office is visible from the main road.
example.zh: 從大馬路就能看到新辦公室。

examples.en: Workers must wear bright vests so they stay visible at night.
examples.zh: 工人必須穿亮色背心，讓他們在夜間保持顯眼。

examples.en: Prices should be visible on every item in the store.
examples.zh: 店裡每項商品的價格都應該看得見。

examples.en: We want our brand to be more visible online this year.
examples.zh: 我們希望今年品牌在網路上更顯眼。

examples.en: Progress on the project is visible in the weekly report.
examples.zh: 專案的進度可以在每週報告中看出來。

confusable.diff: visual 是「視覺的」，說明和眼睛、圖像有關；visible 是「看得見的」，說明東西能被看到。

example.en: The visual design of the app is simple and clean.
example.zh: 這個應用程式的視覺設計簡單又乾淨。

similar.diff: noticeable 強調容易被注意到，也可用在聲音、變化等看不到的事物；visible 通常指眼睛看得到。

example.en: There was a noticeable increase in sales after the new ad.
example.zh: 新廣告推出後，銷售額有明顯的成長。

similar.diff: 比較口語，是 visible 的簡單說法。

example.en: The exit signs are easy to see from every seat.
example.zh: 從每個座位都很容易看到出口標示。

example.en: The instructions were clear, so everyone finished quickly.
example.zh: 說明很清楚，所以大家很快就完成了。

example.en: It was obvious that customers liked the new design.
example.zh: 很明顯顧客喜歡這個新設計。

example.en: The hotel room has a nice view of the sea.
example.zh: 這間飯店房間有很棒的海景。

derived.link: visible 去掉 -le 加 -ly，變成副詞，像 clearly、simply
visible 的 -ble 改成 -bility，變成名詞，像 able → ability
in- 表示「不」，加在 visible 前面，像 incorrect、inactive

senses.en: able to be seen with the eyes

example.en: The camera is visible from the street, so thieves avoid the shop.
example.zh: 從街上就看得到攝影機，所以小偷會避開這家店。

senses.en: easy to notice or clearly shown
senses.distinguish: 後面接 results、change、improvement 等抽象名詞時，通常是「明顯的」，不是真的用眼睛看。

example.en: The new training program has led to visible results.
example.zh: 新的訓練計畫已經帶來了明顯的成果。

extra_vocab.en: to put something in a certain place
extra_vocab.note: 文章中 The baby is also positioned closer to the traffic 是被動式，意思是嬰兒「被放在」更靠近車流的位置。這裡 position 當動詞用，說明推車設計造成的安全問題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: position 當動詞是及物動詞，要有受詞；被動式 be positioned 後面常接地點，如 be positioned near、beside、in front of。

example.en: The company has opened three new positions in the sales team.
example.zh: 公司在業務團隊開了三個新職缺。

example.en: She positions the camera so everyone can see the screen.
example.zh: 她把相機放在適當位置，讓大家都能看到螢幕。

example.en: The booth was positioned near the entrance to attract more visitors.
example.zh: 展位被安排在入口附近，以吸引更多訪客。

example.en: We are positioning the new service for small business owners.
example.zh: 我們正把這項新服務定位給小型企業主。

example.en: I would like to apply for a position in your marketing team.
example.zh: 我想應徵貴公司行銷團隊的一個職位。

collocations.phrase: be in a good position to
collocations.zh: 有利於…、處在適合…的位置

example.en: Our team is in a good position to win the contract.
example.zh: 我們的團隊處在很有利於贏得合約的位置。

collocations.zh: 把 A 定位成 B

example.en: The company positions its new phone as a budget model.
example.zh: 公司把新手機定位成平價機型。

examples.en: Please position the display table next to the main entrance.
examples.zh: 請把展示桌放在大門旁邊。

examples.en: The printer is in a convenient position near the front desk.
examples.zh: 印表機放在櫃台附近很方便的位置。

examples.en: She was offered a senior position in the finance department.
examples.zh: 她獲得財務部門一個資深職位的聘請。

examples.en: I would like to hear your position on the new budget.
examples.zh: 我想聽聽你對新預算的立場。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音近似，但 possession 是「擁有、持有」，和位置無關。

example.en: Possession of this card allows you to enter the building.
example.zh: 持有這張卡就可以進入大樓。

confusable.diff: opposition 是「反對」，字尾和 position 一樣，但前面多了 op-。

example.en: There was strong opposition to the new parking rules.
example.zh: 新的停車規定遭到強烈反對。

similar.diff: place 更常見也更口語，只是把東西放下；position 強調放在特定、精確的位置或方向。

example.en: Please place the samples on the table by the door.
example.zh: 請把樣品放在門邊的桌上。

similar.diff: put 最口語，是最簡單的說法；position 較正式，有刻意安排位置的意思。

example.en: Put the boxes next to the loading door, please.
example.zh: 請把箱子放在裝卸門旁邊。

example.en: Our new store has a great location near the station.
example.zh: 我們的新店位在車站附近，地點很棒。

example.en: Her role in the team is to manage customer orders.
example.zh: 她在團隊中的職責是管理客戶訂單。

example.en: He started a new job at a travel company in May.
example.zh: 他五月在一家旅行社開始了新工作。

derived.link: re- 表示「再一次」，加在 position 前面，像 rewrite、redo、restart

example.en: Please position the chairs in a circle before the workshop starts.
example.zh: 工作坊開始前，請把椅子排成一圈。

example.en: The map shows the exact position of each warehouse.
example.zh: 地圖上標出了每個倉庫的確切位置。

senses.en: to put something in a certain place or direction

example.en: The staff positioned the banner above the stage before the event.
example.zh: 活動前，工作人員把布條掛在舞台上方。

senses.en: to show a product to customers in a certain way
senses.distinguish: 受詞是品牌、產品或服務，後面常接 as 或 for，就是「定位」，不是擺放東西。

example.en: We want to position our brand as a safe choice for families.
example.zh: 我們想把品牌定位成家庭安心的選擇。

senses.en: a job in a company or team
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 apply for、hold、offer 等動詞，或接 in the + 部門，就是「職位」。

example.en: He has held the same position at this company for five years.
example.zh: 他在這家公司擔任同一個職位已經五年了。

senses.distinguish: 後面常接 on + 議題，如 position on the budget，就是「對…的立場」。

example.en: The union explained its position on the new work schedule.
example.zh: 工會說明了對新工作時程的立場。
